title: Seven LCFs against 32 on the test links, once: DAgger net2 on net1 v7 (r29) beside net1 v10 (r27), 11 policies
description: The one test-link run of round 29: round 27's online DAgger recipe unchanged on net1 v7 (exp-net1v6-229), which has net1 v10's data and training spec but only expliCCit's seven hand-picked heads, reading the means (exp-net2-r29-v7-278, r29-means), training seeds 1 to 3. Its iteration was chosen on the validation links at campaign seed 21 by its five-family mean over its training seeds (exp-dagger7-iter-val-279): iteration 39 (+0.152 over its three seeds, against +0.147 at 19 and +0.134 at 59; round 27 at iteration 59 scored +0.150 in the same run). Beside it, round 27 (net1 v10, 32 LCFs) at iteration 59 (seeds 1 and 3, its chosen iteration) and 39 (seeds 1 to 3, its three-seed check), as in exp-dagger32-test-275, so both arms are scored in one release. Reference lines only: the fixed rule at u = 0.25 on net1 v7 (rule-v7, round 29's teacher), net1 v10 (rule-v10) and net1 v9 (rule-v9, to tie this run to releases 258, 272 and 275, whose links and campaigns these are). The five families (training seed 13, others 31), the held-out competitors (BBRv3 and Westwood) and 2 and 4 copies. Question, with the criterion stated before the results: the two arms count as comparable if their seed-mean five-family scores differ by less than round 27's seed range (about 0.015). Nothing is chosen or tuned on these links.
prepare: N7="$IN/v7/$(cat "$IN/v7/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; N10="$IN/v10/$(cat "$IN/v10/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; N9="$IN/v9/$(cat "$IN/v9/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v7" "$N7" --u 0.25; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v10" "$N10" --u 0.25; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v9" "$N9" --u 0.25; P=(--policy "rule-v7=$OUT/v7/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "rule-v10=$OUT/v10/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "rule-v9=$OUT/v9/rule-u0.25.onnx"); (cd "$IN/x" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); (cd "$IN/y" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); for f in "$IN"/y/ppo-r29-means-s*-i39.onnx "$IN"/x/ppo-r27-means-s*-i59.onnx "$IN"/x/ppo-r27-means-s*-i39.onnx; do n="$(basename "$f" .onnx)"; n="${n#ppo-}"; it="${n##*-}"; b="${n%-*}"; P+=(--policy "${b%-*}-$it-${b##*-}=$f"); done; [ "${#P[@]}" -eq 22 ]; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" test 13 31 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/heldout.py "$OUT/spec-held-competitors-60" --split test --family held-competitors --duration-ms 60000 --seed 31 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-held-competitors-60/campaign.json" "$OUT/c-held-competitors-60"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split test --duration-ms 30000 --seed 31 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart held-competitors-60 copies-30s && uv run python experiments/versus_rule.py "$OUT" rule-v10
